Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable collection (MS_MUTABLE_COLLECTION)
Bug_Details:
A mutable collection instance is assigned to a final static field,
  thus can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package.
  Consider wrapping this field into Collections.unmodifiableSet/List/Map/etc.
  to avoid this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: The 'BUGGY_LIST' is mutable and was assigned to a final static field. Hence, it can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package. It can be prevented by wrapping this field into Collections.unmodifiableList to avoid this vulnerability.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by adding 'Malicious content' to the BUGGY_LIST in the showBug() method. The test then compares the expected and actual results.
